description_en: Queries information about network instances attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeCenAttachedChildInstances接口查询云企业网实例下已加载的网络实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-cen-attached-child-instances --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cen-id cen-j3jzhw1zpau2km0000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id cn-zhangjiakou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCenAttachedChildInstances

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging query. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为10，取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud.

VBR: virtual border router.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型，取值：

VPC：专有网络实例。

VBR：边界路由器实例。

CCN：云连接网实例
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.                   

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。                   

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

ChildInstance.description_en: The list of network instances attached to the CEN instance
ChildInstance.description_zh: 云企业网实例加载的网络实例信息列表

ChildInstanceAttachTime.description_en:
The time when the network instance was attached.

The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format
ChildInstanceAttachTime.description_zh:
网络实例的加载时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ

ChildInstanceOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the network instance belongs
ChildInstanceOwnerId.description_zh: 网络实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID

ChildInstanceRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the network instance

ChildInstanceType.description_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud.

VBR: virtual border router.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network
ChildInstanceType.description_zh:
网络实例的类型，取值：

VPC：专有网络实例。

VBR：边界路由器实例。

CCN：云连接网实例

ManagedService.description_en: The cloud service to which the network instance belongs. This parameter is returned only when a VPC used by a cloud service is connected to a transit router. If the VPC is managed by you, this parameter is not returned
ManagedService.description_zh: 网络实例所归属的云服务，只有云服务占用的VPC连接到TR时才会返回对应云服务的标准Code。如果是您自行管理的VPC，则不返回

Status.description_en:
The status of the network instance. Valid values:

Attaching: being attached.

Attached: attached.

Detaching: being detached
Status.description_zh:
网络实例的状态，取值：

Attaching：加载中。

Attached：已加载。

Detaching：卸载中

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数
